title: Your holiday match has an “easy investment”
scenario: Someone you met on a dating app during your trip has been chatting with you daily. After a few weeks they show screenshots of profitable trades and offer to guide you through a small crypto investment “just for fun.”

answers.A: Research the investment platform independently and ask a financially knowledgeable person you trust before doing anything.
answers.B: Try a very small amount first and withdraw it successfully before considering more.
answers.C: Keep romance and investing separate; do not fund or connect a wallet based on guidance from a new online relationship.

explanation: Romance-investment scams often build trust over time and may allow small withdrawals to deepen commitment.
proTip: A successful small withdrawal can be part of the script.
